children: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Tuesday that U.S. bond yields are showing that inflation expectations are "flat to down" and reflect accelerating U.S. growth.
Bessent made the comments at an event on the sidelines of the U.S.-hosted Group of 20 finance leaders in Asheville, North Carolina.

title: US bond yields reflect 'flat to down' inflation expectations, stronger growth, Bessent says
